info.title: CDA Validator API
info.description: Stateless local CDA XML validation. Documents are not persisted or logged. Results apply to the selected, pinned profile and its disclosed coverage. A 200 response does not mean that a document is valid.

post.summary: Validate one UTF-8 CDA XML document
post.description: Runs strict XML parsing, the pinned CDA XSD, and the selected full HL7 Schematron. Default maximum decoded UTF-8 XML size 20 MiB, configurable with MAX_XML_MIB. GET /v1/profiles advertises active limits. Serialized JSON allowance is six times the XML limit plus 64 KiB to allow escaping; maximum 2,000 findings. Supply Authorization: Bearer TOKEN when API_TOKEN is configured. Admitted uploads wait up to 30 seconds for memory, then validation has a separate 30-second deadline; cancellation is cooperative. The total HTTP upload/read window is bounded to 65 seconds. Unknown profiles are rejected rather than guessed. JSON decoding is streamed; duplicate or unknown fields are rejected. Profile IDs are limited to 128 UTF-8 bytes. Admitted uploads queue automatically for shared memory. HTTP 429 indicates the bounded request capacity is full; HTTP 503 indicates the 30-second upload queue wait expired.

xml.description: XML text, never a file path or URL

200.description: Validation report; inspect status and validationComplete

413.description: Request or document exceeds size limit

429.description: Bounded request capacity is full; Retry-After: 2

503.description: Upload queue wait expired or service is stopping

500.description: Engine failure; may include a partial report with validationComplete false

get.summary: List pinned profiles, source checksums, and coverage limitations

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON, field types, UTF-8, or empty XML

validationComplete.description: All configured stages completed, no truncation, and no recorded upstream conversion gaps. Not a claim of clinical correctness or universal terminology conformance.

executionComplete.description: Configured engine stages completed and findings were not truncated

uploadQueueWaitMs.description: Time waiting for upload memory, before decoding
